updates.tweet_text: Forcing trades kills win rate and to avoid it, I always ask myself two questions before entry: 1) Was this entry/zone part of my trade plan? 2) Does it correspond to one of my 3 setup types I've drilled thousands of times? Yes on both eliminates impulse trades, ramps win rate
